original_test_intent: Verify each Type 7 Cache Configuration bitfield correctly encodes cache level, socketed state, location, enabled state and operational mode for the identified cache instance, preserves reserved bits and remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 7 records, retain the configuration UINT16 per handle, decode each subfield with applicable SMBIOS definitions, validate level/location/socketed/enabled/mode against the platform cache map and Type 4 references, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves expected per-cache configuration subfields, reserved-bit policy, topology mapping and reboot plan. Raw decoding and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Expected level, socketed flag, location, enabled state and operational mode for each Type 7 handle
Applicable SMBIOS Cache Configuration bit definitions and reserved-bit policy
Expected Type 4 cache-handle relationships and cache hierarchy
Treatment of unknown/reserved location or mode encodings
Validated raw/decoded parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not alter cache modes, enablement, CPU state, BIOS settings or firmware.
Preserve raw 16-bit configuration and decode every subfield; one rendered line cannot prove reserved bits or individual flag correctness.
Validate encoded cache level against Type 4 L1/L2/L3 references and other Type 7 attributes; do not trust the designation string alone.
Do not translate `Unknown`, reserved or varying operational modes into a guessed write policy.
Stop on reserved-bit violations, impossible level/link combinations, unapproved drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect per-handle raw Cache Configuration, decode all defined subfields, resolve Type 4 relations and compare approved topology/policy before/after reboot.
Do not change cache controls, reinterpret unknown modes or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-cache configuration values, SMBIOS bit definitions and reserved/unknown handling.
Approve topology/reboot recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep loses the raw UINT16, handle and adjacent Type 7 context and therefore cannot independently validate level, location, enabled, socketed, mode and reserved bits.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 7 records, extract the configuration word per handle and emit a structured subfield decode with relevant Type 4 reference checks.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Cache Configuration scope, Type 7 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the raw configuration word into level, socketed, location, enabled and operational-mode components, retain reserved bits, bind by Type 7 handle and validate cross-field/Type 4 topology before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, CPU/cache topology and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 7 Cache Configuration bitfield definitions, Type 4 cache-handle semantics, approved platform cache topology and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw subfield-level and relational validation instead of comparing only a decoder-rendered fragment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage by detecting reserved bits and internally inconsistent cache hierarchy data.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-cache configuration matrix and bit policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The field reports firmware metadata, not a command to change cache operating mode; OS cache presentation may use different abstractions.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve handle-specific location or mode values, including documented unknown/varying states, but must define the exact encoded policy and cache hierarchy.
expected_evidence: Approved configuration matrix, SMBIOS bit definitions, Type 4 relationship map and tool versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 7 records with handle, raw configuration word and decoded subfields/reserved bits
Cross-check of level/enabled/location/mode with approved cache topology and Type 4 references
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot comparison
Engineer verdict with disposition of any unknown or varying mode
